description: LAUNCHING SOON: answers 503 until event discovery goes live. Find public events on Luma and Partiful in one city, soonest first, in one record shape for both platforms: title, url, start and end in UTC and in local time with the offset, timezone, city, venue, Luma's own category, the guest count where the host shows it (null when hidden), hosts with their platform ids, the organiser, and ticket price. Read logged out, never with an account. `sources` says per platform whether it was read (`ok`), does not cover the city or filter (`not_covered`, Partiful publishes no category) or could not be read now (`unreadable`). Costs $0.0015 per event returned; an empty page is free. `events_cities` lists the cities. Page with `cursor`. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

category.description: Luma category: ai, tech, crypto, arts, climate, fitness, wellness, food, books, games, family or running.

city.description: A city slug such as `sf`, `nyc` or `london`, or a city name; `events_cities` lists them.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`.

free.description: true for free events only, false for paid only.

host.description: A host or organiser name or handle contains this text.

min_guests.description: At least this many guests (only events that show their count match).

since.description: Earliest start day in the city's own time, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD); default today.

speaker.description: A speaker, host or the title names this person.

until.description: Latest start day in the city's own time, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: events_search
title: Search Events
